reading.body:
Data Foundry Austin 1 occupies 40,000 square feet of technical space in Travis County, Texas, but the operator has not published a power figure, so its capacity for AI workloads cannot be assessed from available data.

The absence of a megawatt specification places this facility outside the subset of Texas data centers for which power data exists. Texas has 133 mapped facilities in total, with only 13 publishing power figures that sum to 389 MW. Austin 1's unpublished power ranking means it does not contribute to any state-level capacity total, though this reflects a data gap rather than a measured position. The majority of Texas facilities follow the same pattern, making Austin 1 typical rather than exceptional in that regard.

Floor area signals a mid-sized colocation facility rather than a hyperscale deployment. Whether a campus can support GPU clusters depends entirely on power density per rack and total available power. Neither figure is public here. Until the operator publishes power specifications, this campus cannot be ranked against others or evaluated for its role in AI infrastructure scaling.
